1. Blocking architecture violation: the new `issue children`, `issue progress`, and `query count` behavior is orchestrated directly in [main.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/main.rs:2012) and [main.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/main.rs:4873). Those blocks resolve issues through `executor.show_issue`, choose missing-child behavior, build rollups, and construct JSON/text output inline. Under the stated layering rules, command orchestration belongs in `commands/`, with `main.rs` limited to CLI dispatch and output concerns.

2. Blocking correctness issue: container rollups silently drop dangling dependency edges. `issue children` uses `if let Ok(child) = executor.show_issue(dep_id)` at [main.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/main.rs:2023), and `issue progress` uses `.filter_map(|dep_id| executor.show_issue(dep_id).ok())` at [main.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/main.rs:2065). If the dependency DAG contains a missing child, the command reports fewer children and a lower `total` instead of surfacing the broken edge. This undermines REQ-01/REQ-02 because membership is the DAG, and it misses the required missing-issues edge coverage.

3. Documentation/API hygiene gap: new public API surfaces lack the required `# Examples` documentation. `StateCount` and its public fields are added at [output.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/output.rs:1172), `StateRollup::from_issues` and `to_lines` are public methods without `# Examples` at [output.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/output.rs:1237), `ContainerHeader` lacks an example and has undocumented public `title`/`state` fields at [output.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/output.rs:1293), and `CountDimension` lacks an example at [cli.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/cli.rs:2196). The review criteria require all public APIs to include doc comments with descriptions and `# Examples`.
